'''Fawste''' was an [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Ascendancy]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served with [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{GameDS}}
In [[3642 BBY]], Fawste planned to defect to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] since he saw how evil the Empire was. He delivered valuable information to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Karastace Gonn]], who was successful in gathering many Imperial traitors to defect to the Republic. However, [[Darth Baras]] discovered that Fawste was meeting with General Gonn on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and sent [[Empire's Wrath|his apprentice]] to eliminate them. After killing Gonn, Fawste begged the [[Sith Warrior]] to spare him, but the apprentice ignored his plea and [[Death/Legends|killed]] him on the spot.<ref name="Set the Table" />
{{Endgame}}
